args.content:
Hawaii Packing List

Based on Emma Johnson's Hawaii Vacation Plans (June 10th - June 20th, 2024)

Essential Items:
- Swimwear (multiple sets for beach days)
- Sunscreen (high SPF, water-resistant)
- Hiking gear (comfortable shoes, water bottle)
- Casual outfits (light, breathable clothing)
- Camera (for capturing memories)
- Travel documents (passport, ID, tickets)

Additional Recommendations:
- Beach towel
- Hat and sunglasses
- Sandals
- Light jacket (for air conditioning)
- Snorkeling gear (if not provided)
- Reusable water bottle
- Insect repellent
- First aid kit
- Power bank
